text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, May 11, 2018 Posted by admin on May 11th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Appple (AAPL), Cisco (CSCO), Microsoft (MSFT) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +32 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +196.99 (+0.80%) at 24,739.53.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +0.08%.
There were 29 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) +2.24%, UnitedHealth (UNH) +1.96%, Verizon (VZ) +1.77% and Disney (DIS) +1.71%..
The Dow stock loser Thursday was Nike (NKE) -0.04%.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up 1.4 cents at $2.858 per gallon.
